scope: Selected non-secret summary of the complete private application pilot; this repository is not a standalone app and does not reproduce its full fingerprint.
notes: Invite-only friends/family pilot deployed and verified; owner controls individual link distribution. No anonymous analytics demo or LinkedIn post.
Actual cloud checks covered separate-account chat isolation, roles, same-origin protection, quotas, durable activity after restart, immediate revocation, file protection and mobile layouts.
Synthetic verification accounts are disabled and are not real adoption. No real tester invitations have been created by the agent.
Provider/model/snapshot-specific cases and representative checks do not establish universal correctness, uptime or scale.
Private deployment identifiers, URLs, credentials, database image, account details and conversations are excluded.

Owner-operated confirmed password setup and ordinary sign-in were verified; the owner reported regular/Incognito access, with the regular external Owner invitation view visually verified. No credential/account details are exported.
